info.title: Mallakhamb Competition API
info.description:
Competition management for Mallakhamb India: registration, squad entry,
payment, panel seating, live judging and results.

### Versioning
Every path is served at BOTH `/api/v1/...` and `/api/...`. The unversioned
form is an alias kept for the deployed client and should be retired one
release after clients move over. Only the unversioned form is listed here;
prefix it with `/v1` for the versioned equivalent.

### Authentication
Login sets httpOnly `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies AND returns
the access token in the body. Browser clients should rely on the cookies.
Non-browser clients send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

### CSRF
Cookie-authenticated state-changing requests must carry `X-CSRF-Token`,
fetched from `GET /api/csrf-token`. Requests carrying an `Authorization:
Bearer` header are exempt, because a cross-site attacker cannot set headers.

### Competition context
Most admin, coach and judge routes act inside ONE competition. The id is
resolved from the access token first (set it with `POST
/api/auth/set-competition`), then the `X-Competition-Id` header, then
`competitionId` in the body or query. Routes that require it are marked, and
return `COMPETITION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` when none is found.

### Errors
Failures are `{ success: false, error: { message, code, details? } }`.
`details` maps a field name to its message on a validation failure.

JudgeSlipBreakdown.description:
COP §3.3 section marks. Each section is capped and the total may not exceed 10.00.

`difficulty` and `combination` are OBJECTS carrying a `total` plus the selections behind it — the element list and the checklist — so re-opening a slip restores the exact selections rather than only the section total. `execution` and `bonus` are plain numbers.

Sending a bare number for `difficulty` or `combination` is not rejected: the server reads `.total` off it, gets `undefined`, and treats the section as 0. Send the object form.

checklist.description: The per-apparatus checklist; a failed item deducts its penalty.

judgeScores.description: seat → mark, e.g. { seniorJudge: 8.6, judge1: 8.4, judge2: 8.5 }

deduction.description: Time deduction recorded by the Scorer

Score.description: One document per (team, gender, ageGroup, competition, competitionType) — the unique index `score_identity_unique`.

SaveScoreRequest.description:
Two shapes share this endpoint.

**Single judge slip** — `playerId` + `score` (+ optional `breakdown`). The panel seat written is resolved from the caller's own assignment for THIS category; a `judgeType` in the body is ignored unless the caller is a Senior Judge overriding, or an admin recording on the panel's behalf.

**Bulk sheet** — `playerScores[]`, used by the Scorer and admin screens.

judgeType.description: Honoured only for admins, or a Senior Judge with `overrideBySenior`

isFinalSubmit.description: Senior Judge only — finalizes and locks this athlete's result
